randomGenerator: std::mt19937_64; integer draws use modulo; floating draws use the upper53bits

searchLimits.initialSeedEdges: both cells at least60touch-graph boundary rings away; planted reference controls have their explicitly stored seeds
searchLimits.seedSize: 2–6, with all three nonzero states permitted
searchLimits.recurrenceScreen: 64-bit complete-state hash; no recurrence proof is inferred from this screen

counting: Genotype-and-seed duplicates are rejected within each epoch, not globally. Trials, reported phenotype buckets and mathematical structures are different counts. Screened/ablated replays are validation, not added to the two bulk discovery totals.

selectedProvenance.explanation: Epoch11 starts with fresh random rules only; elites reset between epochs. Mutation does not cross genomes and preserves lineage. This selected genome is not descended from a planted Edmond or SIMPLE table. Fitness and simulator design were informed by known gliders.
selectedProvenance.relayReduction: Removing the two state3-producing rows changes anatomy. Removing the promotion empty-neighbour guard is another simplification, separately checked. The final two-row rule is not asserted equivalent to the four-row rule.
selectedProvenance.literatureRelationship: The three-state relay resembles the published Spectre relay family. Independent provenance does not establish priority or absence of earlier equivalent rules.

matureTrajectoryScreen.initialScreen: all six bijective nonzero-state relabellings; independent verifier additionally checks non-injective projections

wake.scope: Compared against included published parents; not a proof of historical priority. Original seven-row and reduced four-row full trajectories agree through1049 generations after transplantation to depth6.

relay.interpretation: The selected mature flight is a relabelling of the published Spectre relay. This is a credited adaptation/transfer, not a distinct newly discovered mature mechanism; launch dynamics and the global rule differ.
